_rule: Clip-level test labels for test3, checked by eye on frames every 2 s (23.11.2026). positive: seconds in which a physical ambulance (white with red strips, or the older 112 livery) is visible; ignore: seconds where it is unclear (studio screens, picture-in-picture, scene with an ambulance hidden or too far to tell), not scored; a video with no positive interval was checked to have no ambulance in the sampled frames. Excluded: duplicates of another test3 video, videos where the ambulance cannot be told apart, and a caption-only video with the crash off-frame. Never used for training or for choosing any setting. Sampling every 2 s can miss a short appearance; any alarm in an ambulance-free video is checked by eye before it counts as false.
